title: Oversight Gap Duration Threshold: How Long Can an Agent Operate Unsupervised Before Cascade Risk Becomes Unacceptable?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: vary oversight gap duration -> measure cascade harm -> fit harm-vs-gap curve -> inform oversight frequency design. Directly produces a design parameter for production systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires setting up an agent on a 30-step task with oversight gap simulation and harmful trigger injection. Moderate complexity; the gap simulation and harm measurement need careful design but use standard tools.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: harm-vs-gap-duration curve. Five gap conditions on one task type with clear metric. Well-defined first milestone. Achievable in 30 hours with medium compute.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
